sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. After a recent loss, Sandbach will look to bounce back against one of the division's struggling sides; Alsager sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, offering an opportunity to keep pace with league leaders. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth face Eccleshall at home in a potentially close contest between teams in good standing. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, travel to Wednesfield Community in midweek action on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town, enjoying a strong season in sixth, host Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter bottom of the form table with five consecutive defeats. In-form Crewe travel to face Allscott Heath, and New Mills host Market Drayton Town in what could go either way given their comparable league positions. Telford Town, battling near the bottom, visit Cheadle Heath Nomads in a fixture between struggling sides. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home on Saturday before hosting Wednesfield Community in midweek, seeking to improve from their recent patchy form. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in another fixture between the division's weaker-performing teams.
